summary: The candidate talks about public safety through who answers the call and how many are on the street, and names the job police are asked to do that others could.
realLife: Mayoral candidates in New York and Chicago spoke about police in terms of staffing, trust in leadership, and which calls an officer should and should not answer. One favored specially trained officers working beside mental health workers; one favored dedicated outreach teams so police are not sent on every mental health call; one promised more officers on neighborhood patrol and fewer at desks.
